verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs show extensive program-management tooling (card creation, velocity/authorization controls, JIT funding, disputes, sandbox simulations, webhooks) that lets a founder run a card program without building infrastructure themselves, implying the platform handles the underlying issuing complexity. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions BIN sponsorship or network membership arrangements, nor any documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/bank-partner language, network membership details, and a documented time-to-launch metric.
